errors.invalid_request: The request was invalid. This is a bug in the app.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.not_implemented: This feature is not available yet.
errors.busy: Another task is still running. Try again when it has finished.
errors.timeout: This took too long and was stopped.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.site_unavailable: edikte.justiz.gv.at is not responding. Try again later.
errors.site_changed: edikte.justiz.gv.at returned a page the app cannot read. The site may have changed.
errors.rate_limited: edikte.justiz.gv.at is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.document_too_large: The document is larger than the app's download limit.
errors.document_unreadable: The PDF could not be read. It may be damaged or protected.
errors.storage_unavailable: The app cannot write to its data folder. Check free disk space and folder permissions.
errors.database_newer: The data folder was created by a newer version of Edikte. Install that version to open it.
errors.consent_required: Confirm first that the appraisal report text may be sent to your AI provider.
errors.provider_not_selected: Choose an AI provider in Settings first.
errors.provider_not_connected: The selected AI provider is not signed in. Sign in under Settings.
errors.provider_auth: The AI provider rejected the sign-in or API key. Sign in again or check the key.
errors.provider_billing: The AI provider reports a billing or plan problem. Check your account with the provider.
errors.provider_rate_limit: You have reached the AI provider's usage limit. Try again later.
errors.provider_refused: The AI model declined this request.
errors.provider_incomplete: The AI model stopped before finishing its answer.
errors.provider_invalid_output: The AI model's answer did not have the expected format.
errors.provider_unavailable: The AI provider cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.provider_account_changed: The signed-in account changed during the analysis, so the result was discarded.
errors.cli_not_found: The command-line tool was not found. Install it or choose its file in Settings.
errors.cli_update_required: This version of the command-line tool lacks options the app needs. Update it and try again.
errors.cli_failed: The command-line tool stopped with an error.
errors.internal: An unexpected error occurred in the app.
